item_short_desc: Rothco's Enhanced Mosquito Net Bar is an excellent way to protect your cot or bed from mosquitos and other insects. The mosquito net measures 79" x 32" x 59" with reinforced edges and corners with ties. The bug netting is mildew resistant and has a fine mesh for extra protection against insects. Great for camping or the outdoors.
